latest_final: The ransom demand is addressed to the daughter: the kidnapper tells her to bring one hundred million yen alone by noon tomorrow, with no police. The father understands that complying would require his daughter—who is currently safe and away—to come out alone to deliver the money. He therefore refuses to pay, because doing so would draw his daughter into the kidnapper's reach and endanger her, rather than rescue the supposed hostage. The call is best understood as a trap aimed at the daughter; the father's decision not to pay is a deliberate choice to keep her out of danger.
